title: Global View - Daylight Savings Time

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about something that has always been very confusing for me.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是一些让我很困惑的事情。

segments.en: For me as well.
segments.zh: 对我来说也是如此。

segments.en: I don't understand very well what this is about.
segments.zh: 我不太明白这是怎么回事。

segments.en: We're going to be talking about time zones and a little bit about daylight savings time.
segments.zh: 我们将讨论时区和一些夏令时。

segments.en: Before we get started though, let's take a look at this phrase in today's vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 在我们开始之前，让我们在今天的词汇预览中看看这句话。

segments.en: Vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 词汇预习。

segments.en: All right, so the phrase is daylight savings time.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这句话是夏令时。

segments.en: Okay, so we're trying to save daylight pretty much.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们几乎要节省日光。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is the time of year when we change our clocks.
segments.zh: 所以这是一年中我们改变时钟的时候。

segments.en: What does that mean?
segments.zh: 那是什么意思？

segments.en: That means in the fall there's a special day and everyone has it on their calendar and we change the clocks.
segments.zh: 这意味着在秋天有一个特殊的日子，每个人的日历上都有它，我们改变了时钟。

segments.en: We put them back one hour.
segments.zh: 我们把它们放回一小时。

segments.en: So if it was eight o'clock now it's seven o'clock.
segments.zh: 所以如果现在是八点钟，那是七点钟。

segments.en: Okay, so everything is earlier, starts earlier.
segments.zh: 好吧，一切都更早，更早开始。

segments.en: And that's basically to take advantage of the daylight, right?
segments.zh: 这基本上是为了利用日光，对吧？

segments.en: That's why it's called daylight savings time.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么它被称为夏令时。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And so that's for the winter and then when the winter's past we change the clocks again.
segments.zh: 那是为了冬天，然后当冬天过去时，我们再次改变了时钟。

segments.en: We have the spring daylight savings where we change our clocks ahead.
segments.zh: 我们有春光节约，我们可以在未来改变我们的时钟。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So it sounds kind of complicated.
segments.zh: 所以听起来有点复杂。

segments.en: Many countries don't have daylight savings time.
segments.zh: 许多国家没有夏令时。

segments.en: They don't change their clocks at all.
segments.zh: 他们根本不改变他们的时钟。

segments.en: But we're going to be talking about this in a little bit more so why don't we listen to our dialogue for the first time.
segments.zh: 但我们将在更多时间讨论这个问题，所以我们为什么不第一次听我们的对话。

segments.en: Did you set your clock forward for daylight savings time?
segments.zh: 夏令时开始了，你把钟拨快了吗？

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Why do we have to do that?
segments.zh: 为什么我们必须这样做？

segments.en: Well, at the start of the spring we usually have more daylight in the mornings and less in the afternoon.
segments.zh: 好吧，在春天开始时，我们通常在早上有更多的日光，而在下午的时间更少。

segments.en: This is basically due to our position on the planet and the rotation of the Earth.
segments.zh: 这基本上是由于我们在地球上的位置和地球的自转。

segments.en: In any case, to take better advantage of the daylight available we compensate by moving our clocks forward one hour.
segments.zh: 无论如何，为了更好地利用可用的日光，我们通过将时钟向前移动一小时来进行补偿。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: That's convenient.
segments.zh: 这倒方便。

segments.en: I never understood things like this such as GMT.
segments.zh: 我从来没有理解过这样的事情，比如格林威治标准时间。

segments.en: I never know what time zone we are in or when to change my clock.
segments.zh: 我总搞不清咱们在哪个时区，也不知道该什么时候调钟。

segments.en: That just stands for Greenwich Mean Time.
segments.zh: 这只是代表格林威治时间。

segments.en: Here in California we're in Pacific Standard Time.
segments.zh: 在加利福尼亚，我们处于太平洋标准时间。

segments.en: That is eight time zones west of Greenwich.
segments.zh: 那是格林威治以西的八个时区。

segments.en: Remember when we were in Beijing?
segments.zh: 还记得我们在北京的时候吗？

segments.en: Well, then we were in China Standard Time and that's eight time zones east of Greenwich.
segments.zh: 好吧，然后我们在中国标准时间，那是格林威治以东的八个时区。

segments.en: That's why it was so weird traveling from Beijing to LA because of the huge time difference.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么从北京到洛杉矶的旅行如此奇怪，因为时间差异很大。

segments.en: Even though we left Beijing at noon and flew for more than eight hours, we still arrived in LA the same day at noon.
segments.zh: 虽然我们中午离开北京，飞行了八个多小时，但我们仍然在当天中午到达洛杉矶。

segments.en: It's like we went back in time.
segments.zh: 就像我们回到过去一样。

segments.en: Alright we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So that was a pretty clear explanation of why we do these things.
segments.zh: 所以这是对我们为什么做这些事情的一个非常清楚的解释。

segments.en: But maybe there are a couple of words that you didn't understand.
segments.zh: 但也许有几个你不明白的词。

segments.en: So let's take a look at those now in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看现在语言外卖中的那些。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Well, Marco, what you were hinting at before, this idea that we have shorter days in the winter and longer days in the summer has to do with the rotation of the Earth.
segments.zh: 好吧，马可，你之前暗示的，我们在冬天有更短的日子和更长的夏天的日子，这与地球的自转有关。

segments.en: So the rotation of the Earth is our first phrase.
segments.zh: 所以地球的自转是我们的第一个短语。

segments.en: So the Earth rotates.
segments.zh: 于是地球旋转。

segments.en: What does that mean if it rotates?
segments.zh: 如果它旋转是什么意思？

segments.en: Means to spin around.
segments.zh: 意思是旋转。

segments.en: But not just to spin around anywhere.
segments.zh: 但不仅仅是在任何地方旋转。

segments.en: It means that if you draw a line through the middle of something, it never leaves that line.
segments.zh: 这意味着如果你在某物的中间画一条线，它永远不会离开那条线。

segments.en: It just kind of turns.
segments.zh: 它只是有点转。

segments.en: So it's spinning.
segments.zh: 所以它正在旋转。

segments.en: Like the wheels on a car.
segments.zh: 就像汽车上的轮子。

segments.en: They rotate.
segments.zh: 他们旋转。

segments.en: That means they go around but they are fixed to the car.
segments.zh: 这意味着它们四处走动，但它们被固定在汽车上。

segments.en: So this is one of the reasons why we need to compensate our clocks because of the rotation of the Earth.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们需要补偿我们的时钟的原因之一，因为地球的自转。

segments.en: And that's our next word, to compensate.
segments.zh: 这是我们的下一个词，以补偿。

segments.en: This is a verb, to compensate.
segments.zh: 这是一个动词，补偿。

segments.en: And it's often used with money but it can be used with time as well.
segments.zh: 它经常与金钱一起使用，但也可以随时间使用。

segments.en: Time or sunlight.
segments.zh: 时间或阳光。

segments.en: So with money you'd say, I paid him a hundred dollars but I owed him a hundred fifty.
segments.zh: 所以你会说，你会说，我付给他一百美元，但我欠他一百五十。

segments.en: So I'm going to compensate him for the extra fifty.
segments.zh: 所以我要补偿他额外的五十。

segments.en: Means I'm going to fix it.
segments.zh: 意味着我要修复它。

segments.en: So to compensate would be the verb and compensation would be the noun.
segments.zh: 所以补偿将是动词，补偿将是名词。

segments.en: Now in this case we're talking about time.
segments.zh: 现在在这种情况下，我们正在谈论时间。

segments.en: So how can we compensate time?
segments.zh: 那么我们如何补偿时间呢？

segments.en: Well that means that if we have lost an hour because we changed the clocks, we have to compensate.
segments.zh: 好吧，这意味着如果我们因为改变时钟而损失了一个小时，我们必须补偿。

segments.en: We have to try and gain that hour back.
segments.zh: 我们必须尝试并获得那个小时。

segments.en: And so that's why in the spring, after the days start to get longer and longer, we have to compensate for that by changing the clocks again.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么在春天，在日子开始变得越来越长之后，我们必须通过再次更换时钟来弥补这一点。

segments.en: So we're compensating time.
segments.zh: 所以我们正在补偿时间。

segments.en: Now related to daylight savings and this whole time thing is time zones.
segments.zh: 现在与夏令时有关，整个时间都是时区。

segments.en: We have time zones all over the Earth.
segments.zh: 我们在地球上都有时区。

segments.en: And you've probably noticed this if you've traveled.
segments.zh: 如果你旅行过，你可能已经注意到了这一点。

segments.en: You have to change your clocks or many times you see in hotels what time it is in London, in Hong Kong, in Berlin, etc.
segments.zh: 您必须更改时钟或多次在酒店看到伦敦、香港、柏林等的时间。

segments.en: And this makes a lot of sense because like we said, the Earth is rotating and so if it's daylight in Moscow and it's nighttime in New York, obviously it's not the same time.
segments.zh: 这很有意义，因为就像我们说的，地球在旋转，所以如果是莫斯科的白天和纽约的夜晚，显然不是同一时间。

segments.en: So to compensate for this difference, we have different time zones.
segments.zh: 因此，为了弥补这种差异，我们有不同的时区。

segments.en: And each time zone is pretty much an hour or so, you know, half an hour different from the next one.
segments.zh: 每个时区几乎是一个小时左右，你知道，与下一个时区不同。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So most countries actually have different time zones throughout their country unless they're small that they don't really need to compensate any change.
segments.zh: 因此，大多数国家实际上在其国家拥有不同的时区，除非它们很小，因此不需要补偿任何变化。

segments.en: Or for example, China, just to unify everything, it's a big country but they have one time zone.
segments.zh: 或者，例如，中国，只是为了统一一切，它是一个大国，但他们有一个时区。

segments.en: It's China standard time.
segments.zh: 现在是中国标准时间。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: But in the United States, we have four time zones.
segments.zh: 但在美国，我们有四个时区。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's time zone.
segments.zh: 所以这是时区。

segments.en: And the other thing related to time zone is time difference.
segments.zh: 与时区有关的另一件事是时差。

segments.en: Okay, well think about math here.
segments.zh: 好吧，在这里想想数学。

segments.en: Difference is a word that we use in math.
segments.zh: 差异是我们在数学中使用的一个词。

segments.en: And a time difference is the amount of time, that means how many hours there are between one time zone and another time zone.
segments.zh: 时差是时间的量，这意味着一个时区和另一个时区之间有多少小时。

segments.en: So for example, Beijing and New York City.
segments.zh: 例如，北京和纽约市。

segments.en: These are very, very far away from each other.
segments.zh: 这些彼此非常非常远。

segments.en: If it's day in New York, it's night in Beijing.
segments.zh: 如果是纽约的白天，那就是北京的夜晚。

segments.en: So that means if it's seven in the morning in Beijing, it's probably around seven at night in New York.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着如果北京是早上七点，纽约可能是晚上七点左右。

segments.en: So the time difference would be more or less 12 hours.
segments.zh: 所以时差将或多或少 12 小时。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: But when it's daylight savings time, it's 13.
segments.zh: 但是当它是夏令时，它是13。

segments.en: So be careful.
segments.zh: 所以要小心。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: I think that's pretty clear.
segments.zh: 我认为这很清楚。

segments.en: I think we should go back and listen to our dialogue again.
segments.zh: 我认为我们应该回去再听我们的对话。

segments.en: And we'll be back soon with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我们很快就会带着 Fluency Builder 回来。

segments.en: Now let's take a look at three key phrases in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 现在让我们来看看 Fluency Builder 中的三个关键短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: Let's go back to the beginning of this dialogue.
segments.zh: 让我们回到这个对话的开始。

segments.en: The person who's explaining all of these interesting things is saying that, well, in any case, to take better advantage of the daylight available, we compensate by moving our clocks forward one hour.
segments.zh: 解释所有这些有趣事情的人是说，无论如何，为了更好地利用可用的日光，我们通过将时钟向前移动一小时来进行补偿。

segments.en: This is an important phrase you could say to take better advantage of or to take advantage of.
segments.zh: 这是您可以说要更好地利用或利用的一个重要短语。

segments.en: Let's talk about this.
segments.zh: 让我们谈谈这个。

segments.en: To take advantage of something.
segments.zh: 利用某事。

segments.en: So to take advantage of something is to use it efficiently, right?
segments.zh: 所以利用某些东西就是有效地使用它，对吧？

segments.en: Or to take better advantage.
segments.zh: 或更好地利用。

segments.en: So for example, if you drive to work every day and your neighbor drives to work every day and you work at the same place, you could take better advantage of your car and the cost by sharing the same car to work.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果您每天开车上班，而您的邻居每天开车上班，而您在同一个地方工作，您可以通过共享同一辆车上班来更好地利用您的汽车和成本。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Or when people started to use computers, you could say, well, they were taking better advantage of their time by speeding things up, by making things faster with the computers.
segments.zh: 或者当人们开始使用计算机时，你可以说，他们正在更好地利用时间，通过计算机来加快事情的速度，让事情变得更快。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Or many mothers say, take better advantage of your time and read something instead of playing those video games.
segments.zh: 或者许多母亲说，利用你的时间更好地阅读一些东西，而不是玩那些电子游戏。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So it means, like you said, to be more efficient, to do useful or important things.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着，就像你说的，更有效率，做有用或重要的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And now when we talked about what daylight savings time means or GMT, what that stands for.
segments.zh: 现在，当我们谈到夏令时意味着什么或 GMT 时，这代表什么。

segments.en: This is an interesting phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个有趣的短语。

segments.en: It stands for.
segments.zh: 它代表。

segments.en: Well, think about it as a picture.
segments.zh: 好吧，把它想象成一张图片。

segments.en: So if something stands for something else, that means the original thing, it's not there anymore.
segments.zh: 因此，如果某物代表其他事物，则意味着原始事物，它不再存在。

segments.en: And so in words and phrases like GMT, GMT doesn't mean anything by itself.
segments.zh: 因此，在像 GMT 这样的单词和短语中，GMT 本身并没有任何意义。

segments.en: But the G stands for something, the M stands for something.
segments.zh: 但 G 代表某物，M 代表某物。

segments.en: It's an acronym.
segments.zh: 这是个首字母缩略词。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this is an acronym that stands for, that represents three big long words.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个代表的首字母缩写词，代表三个长长的词。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Greenwich, meantime.
segments.zh: 与此同时，格林威治。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So we use this a lot when we are defining words or when we are defining an acronym like GMT stands for Greenwich, meantime.
segments.zh: 因此，当我们定义单词或定义像 GMT 的首字母缩略词代表格林威治的同时，我们经常使用它。

segments.en: Or for example, USA stands for United States of America.
segments.zh: 例如，美国代表美利坚合众国。

segments.en: Or we can even say someone's name stands for something.
segments.zh: 或者我们甚至可以说某人的名字代表某事。

segments.en: So Marco, what is the M in your last name stand for?
segments.zh: 那么马可，你姓氏中的 M 代表什么？

segments.en: So you're Marco M. What does the M stand for?
segments.zh: 所以你是 Marco M。M 代表什么？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And then I would say, well, it stands for Mejia.
segments.zh: 然后我会说，嗯，它代表 Mejia。

segments.en: Your last name.
segments.zh: 你的姓氏。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And then we use this when you see things that you don't understand, maybe an acronym or an abbreviation.
segments.zh: 然后，当您看到您不理解的事物时，我们会使用它，可能是缩写词或缩写词。

segments.en: Like does Cathy stand for Catherine?
segments.zh: 就像凯茜代表凯瑟琳一样吗？

segments.en: Yes, Cathy stands for Catherine.
segments.zh: 是的，凯茜代表凯瑟琳。

segments.en: It's a short version of Catherine.
segments.zh: 这是凯瑟琳的简短版本。

segments.en: Cool.
segments.zh: 明白了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And well now talking a little bit more about time, you've maybe seen the movie Back to the Future and this is what it's all about, to go back in time.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在多谈一点时间，你可能已经看过这部电影回到未来，这就是它的全部意义，回到过去。

segments.en: To go back in time.
segments.zh: 回到过去。

segments.en: So we went back in time.
segments.zh: 所以我们回到了过去。

segments.en: This is what the person says about the flight from Beijing to LA.
segments.zh: 这就是这个人所说的从北京飞往洛杉矶的航班。

segments.en: What's interesting is that to go back in time is kind of a fixed phrase.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，回到过去是一种固定的短语。

segments.en: We always say it like this.
segments.zh: 我们总是这样说。

segments.en: So we could say, if you went back in time, where would you go?
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说，如果你回到过去，你会去哪里？

segments.en: What time?
segments.zh: 什么时间?

segments.en: What place?
segments.zh: 什么地方？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So to go back in time, you usually use it like this.
segments.zh: 所以要回到过去，你通常会这样使用它。

segments.en: Now, what if I wanted to say to go into the future?
segments.zh: 现在，如果我想说去未来怎么办？

segments.en: Could you say, go forward in time?
segments.zh: 你能说，及时前进吗？

segments.en: You could go forward in time or you could go into the future.
segments.zh: 你可以及时前进，也可以进入未来。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Go into the future.
segments.zh: 走向未来。

segments.en: So remember, if you want to talk about going back in time, it's usually traveling to the past.
segments.zh: 所以请记住，如果你想谈谈回到过去，它通常是去过去。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's all the phrases we have.
segments.zh: 这就是我们所有的短语。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to the dialogue for the very last time.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不最后一次听对话。

segments.en: Did you set your clock forward for daylight savings time?
segments.zh: 夏令时开始了，你把钟拨快了吗？

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Why do we have to do that?
segments.zh: 为什么我们必须这样做？

segments.en: Well, at the start of the spring, we usually have more daylight in the mornings and less in the afternoon.
segments.zh: 好吧，在春天开始时，我们通常在早上有更多的日光，而在下午的时间更少。

segments.en: This is basically due to our position on the planet and the rotation of the earth.
segments.zh: 这基本上是由于我们在地球上的位置和地球的自转。

segments.en: In any case, to take better advantage of the daylight available, we compensate by moving our clocks forward one hour.
segments.zh: 无论如何，为了更好地利用可用的日光，我们通过将时钟向前移动一小时来进行补偿。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: That's convenient.
segments.zh: 这倒方便。

segments.en: I never understood things like this, such as GMT.
segments.zh: 我从来没有理解过这样的事情，比如格林威治标准时间。

segments.en: I never know what time zone we are in or when to change my clock.
segments.zh: 我总搞不清咱们在哪个时区，也不知道该什么时候调钟。

segments.en: That just stands for Greenwich Mean Time.
segments.zh: 这只是代表格林威治时间。

segments.en: Here in California, we're in Pacific Standard Time.
segments.zh: 在加利福尼亚，我们处于太平洋标准时间。

segments.en: That is eight time zones west of Greenwich.
segments.zh: 那是格林威治以西的八个时区。

segments.en: Remember when we were in Beijing?
segments.zh: 还记得我们在北京的时候吗？

segments.en: Well, then we were in China Standard Time and that's eight time zones east of Greenwich.
segments.zh: 好吧，然后我们在中国标准时间，那是格林威治以东的八个时区。

segments.en: That's why it was so weird traveling from Beijing to LA, because of the huge time difference.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么从北京到洛杉矶的旅行如此奇怪，因为时间差异很大。

segments.en: Even though we left Beijing at noon and flew for more than eight hours, we still arrived in LA the same day at noon.
segments.zh: 虽然我们中午离开北京，飞行了八个多小时，但我们仍然在当天中午到达洛杉矶。

segments.en: It's like we went back in time.
segments.zh: 就像我们回到过去一样。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: Now, this is actually something that really does happen, right?
segments.zh: 现在，这实际上是真正发生的事情，对吧？

segments.en: If you take off in an airplane from Beijing, you fly for a certain amount of hours and you reach California and it's still the same time.
segments.zh: 如果你从北京乘坐飞机起飞，你飞行了一定的时间，然后到达加利福尼亚，它仍然是同一时间。

segments.en: You reach it in the same day.
segments.zh: 你在同一天到达它。

segments.en: It's very strange.
segments.zh: 这很奇怪。

segments.en: The same thing happens to me when I go home.
segments.zh: 当我回家时，同样的事情也发生在我身上。

segments.en: I leave Shanghai and I arrive in Chicago and I arrive at the exact same time I left on the same day.
segments.zh: 我离开上海，到达芝加哥，我在同一天离开的同一时间到达。

segments.en: It's like time never passed.
segments.zh: 就像时间从未过去一样。

segments.en: It's the longest day of your entire life, because it's not 24 hours.
segments.zh: 这是你一生中最长的一天，因为这不是 24 小时。

segments.en: The flight is 14 hours.
segments.zh: 飞行时间为14小时。

segments.en: It's really 24, 38 hours long, right?
segments.zh: 真的是24小时38小时，对吧？

segments.en: It's really intense and exhausting.
segments.zh: 这真的很激烈而且很累。

segments.en: Then what happens is when you do the opposite.
segments.zh: 那么发生的事情是当你做相反的事情时。

segments.en: You go from Chicago to Shanghai, then you go into the future pretty much, right?
segments.zh: 你从芝加哥到上海，然后你几乎走向未来，对吧？

segments.en: Because you left on a Sunday, but you arrive on a Tuesday.
segments.zh: 因为你是星期天离开的，但你是在星期二到达的。

segments.en: Or in my case, yeah, you leave on a Sunday and you'd arrive on a Monday and you lose half a day of your life.
segments.zh: 或者就我而言，是的，你在星期天离开，你会在星期一到达，你会失去半天的生命。

segments.en: You're just sitting there and all of a sudden it goes past you.
segments.zh: 你只是坐在那里，突然间它从你身边经过。

segments.en: So it all evens out in the end.
segments.zh: 所以这一切最终都平衡了。

segments.en: So when you go back or when you come, it all evens out.
segments.zh: 所以当你回去或当你回来时，一切都变得平衡了。

segments.en: You recover, you get those hours of your life back pretty much.
segments.zh: 你恢复了，你几乎恢复了生命中的那些时间。

segments.en: They're not gone forever.
segments.zh: 他们不会永远消失。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So if you guys have any questions, any doubts, you can send us an email at EnglishPod at PraxisLanguage.com or come to our website EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，如果你们有任何疑问，任何疑问，您可以通过 Praxislanguage.com 的 EnglishPod 向我们发送电子邮件或访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: We hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到你。

segments.en: Ask away and until next time everyone.
segments.zh: 问走，直到下一次大家。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
